title: What Makes a Peer? Valuation-Anchored Similarity in Private Markets
abstract: arXiv:2608.12594v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As more investors contemplate private markets and contend with limited transparency, sparse disclosures, and infrequent transactions, identifying economically meaningful peer companies for comparison is a fundamental challenge for valuation, due diligence, portfolio construction, and risk management. We propose an ensemble tree-based supervised similarity learning framework that defines company similarity through the lens of market valuation rather than static feature matching or semantic descriptions. Specifically, we train a CatBoost gradient-boosted decision tree model on observed private company valuations and derive a valuation-aware similarity metric from importance-weighted leaf-node co-occurrences across the ensemble. The similarity metric captures shared valuation drivers while accommodating nonlinear relationships, mixed data types, and pervasive missing data common in private markets. translated_title: 什么构成同行？私募市场中的估值锚定相似性
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着越来越多的投资者考虑进入私募市场，并面临透明度有限、信息披露稀疏和交易频率低的问题，识别具有经济意义的可比公司成为估值、尽职调查、投资组合构建和风险管理中的根本挑战。我们提出了一种基于集成树的监督式相似性学习框架，该框架通过市场估值的视角来定义公司相似性，而非静态特征匹配或语义描述。具体而言，我们在观察到的私募公司估值上训练了一个CatBoost梯度提升决策树模型，并从集成中基于重要性加权的叶节点共现中推导出一种估值感知的相似性度量。该相似性度量捕捉了共享的估值驱动因素，同时适应非线性关系、混合数据类型以及私募市场中常见的普遍缺失数据。利用全球私募市场数据集...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CatBoost集成树的估值锚定相似性学习框架，通过叶节点共现推导估值感知的相似性度量，以解决私募市场中可比公司识别难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a valuation-anchored similarity learning framework using CatBoost ensemble trees, deriving a valuation-aware similarity metric from leaf-node co-occurrences to address the challenge of identifying comparable companies in private markets.
